## Overview

Every sentinel site and every DPS seat has been geocoded independently by each
enabled provider, through the same query ladder and quality gate. This
document compares those answers. It makes no requests: it reads what
`drc-geocoding-workflow.qmd` and `drc-dps-site-pairs.qmd` wrote, so render
those first.

The **baseline** is the original setup, Google alone. Its column below is
Google's answer under the current gate. Where the snapshot of the original
outputs exists (`../output/baseline/`), it is checked to be identical.

There is no field truth yet, so this benchmark measures **coverage and
agreement**, not accuracy. Two independent sources that put a site at the same
place are evidence that it is there; when they disagree, at least one is wrong,
and the table of disagreements says where to look first. Nominatim and Photon
both serve OpenStreetMap, so agreement between them is not independent; the
cross-check counts source families, not providers.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| eval: true

library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)
library(knitr)

source("config.R")
source("geocode-functions.R")

read_output <- function(file) {
  path <- file.path(paths$output, file)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop(path, " not found. Render drc-geocoding-workflow.qmd and ",
         "drc-dps-site-pairs.qmd first.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

answers <- bind_rows(
  read_output("drc_geocoding_by_provider.csv") |>
    transmute(point_set = "sentinel_site", point_id = site_id, name = sentinel_site,
              province, provider, latitude, longitude, geocode_status, confidence,
              resolved_at_rung, matched_address, matched_kind, quality_flags,
              name_similarity),
  read_output("drc_dps_by_provider.csv") |>
    transmute(point_set = "dps", point_id = dps_id, name = paste0(dps, " (", chef_lieu, ")"),
              province, provider, latitude, longitude, geocode_status, confidence,
              resolved_at_rung, matched_address, matched_kind, quality_flags,
              name_similarity)
)

audit <- bind_rows(
  read_output("drc_geocoding_candidates.csv") |> mutate(point_set = "sentinel_site"),
  read_output("drc_dps_candidates.csv") |> rename(site_id = dps_id) |> mutate(point_set = "dps")
)

stats <- bind_rows(read_output("drc_geocoding_provider_stats.csv"),
                   read_output("drc_dps_provider_stats.csv"))

ran   <- intersect(names(providers), unique(answers$provider))
tiers <- c("high", "medium", "low", "failed")
accepted <- answers |> filter(geocode_status != "failed")

cat("Providers compared:", paste(ran, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Points:", n_distinct(answers$point_id), "(",
    n_distinct(answers$point_id[answers$point_set == "sentinel_site"]), "sentinel sites,",
    n_distinct(answers$point_id[answers$point_set == "dps"]), "DPS seats )\n")
```

## The Baseline Holds

```{r}
#| label: baseline-check
#| eval: true

baseline_files <- c(sentinel_site = "baseline/drc_sentinel_sites_geocoded.csv",
                    dps           = "baseline/drc_dps_geocoded.csv")
id_cols <- c(sentinel_site = "site_id", dps = "dps_id")

if (all(file.exists(file.path(paths$output, baseline_files)))) {
  checks <- imap(baseline_files, function(f, set) {
    base <- read.csv(file.path(paths$output, f), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
      transmute(point_id = .data[[id_cols[[set]]]], b_lat = latitude, b_lon = longitude,
                b_conf = confidence, b_flags = coalesce(quality_flags, ""))
    now <- answers |>
      filter(point_set == set, provider == "google") |>
      transmute(point_id, latitude, longitude, confidence,
                flags = coalesce(quality_flags, ""))
    joined <- inner_join(now, base, by = "point_id")
    tibble(
      `Point set`          = set,
      Points               = nrow(joined),
      `Same coordinates`   = sum(abs(coalesce(joined$latitude - joined$b_lat, 0)) < 1e-9 &
                                   abs(coalesce(joined$longitude - joined$b_lon, 0)) < 1e-9 &
                                   is.na(joined$latitude) == is.na(joined$b_lat)),
      `Same tier`          = sum(joined$confidence == joined$b_conf),
      `Same flags`         = sum(joined$flags == joined$b_flags)
    )
  })
  list_rbind(checks) |>
    kable(caption = "Google under the current gate against the original Google-only outputs")
} else {
  cat("No snapshot of the original outputs in ../output/baseline/, so the Google",
      "column stands in for the baseline unchecked.\n")
}
```

## Coverage and Confidence

```{r}
#| label: coverage
#| eval: true

answers |>
  mutate(provider = factor(provider, levels = ran)) |>
  group_by(`Point set` = point_set, provider) |>
  summarise(
    Points      = n(),
    Resolved    = sum(geocode_status != "failed"),
    high        = sum(confidence == "high"),
    medium      = sum(confidence == "medium"),
    low         = sum(confidence == "low"),
    failed      = sum(confidence == "failed"),
    `Pinned rung` = sum(resolved_at_rung <= 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  rename(Provider = provider) |>
  kable(caption = "What each provider resolved, by confidence tier (google = baseline)")

answers |>
  filter(geocode_status != "failed") |>
  count(point_set, provider, matched_kind) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = matched_kind, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  arrange(point_set, match(provider, ran)) |>
  kable(caption = "Kind of place each provider's accepted answers are")
```

### Union coverage

```{r}
#| label: union-coverage
#| eval: true

by_point <- answers |>
  group_by(point_set, point_id, name) |>
  summarise(n_providers = sum(geocode_status != "failed"),
            n_families  = n_distinct(provider_family(provider[geocode_status != "failed"])),
            google_ok   = any(provider == "google" & geocode_status != "failed"),
            .groups = "drop")

by_point |>
  group_by(`Point set` = point_set) |>
  summarise(
    Points                     = n(),
    `Google (baseline)`        = sum(google_ok),
    `Any provider`             = sum(n_providers > 0),
    `Only Google`              = sum(google_ok & n_providers == 1),
    `Gained over Google`       = sum(!google_ok & n_providers > 0),
    `2+ independent sources`   = sum(n_families >= 2),
    `No provider`              = sum(n_providers == 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Coverage of all providers together")
```

## Google's Failures

What each provider made of the points Google could not resolve. A point that
only one source finds is a candidate, not a confirmation: check it before use.

```{r}
#| label: google-failures
#| eval: true

g_failed <- answers |>
  filter(provider == "google", geocode_status == "failed") |>
  pull(point_id)

if (length(g_failed) == 0) {
  cat("Google resolved every point.\n")
} else {
  answers |>
    filter(point_id %in% g_failed) |>
    mutate(answer = if_else(geocode_status == "failed", "—",
                            sprintf("%s r%d (%.4f, %.4f) %s", confidence, resolved_at_rung,
                                    latitude, longitude, coalesce(matched_kind, "")))) |>
    select(point_set, name, province, provider, answer) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = provider, values_from = answer) |>
    kable(caption = "Points Google failed on: each provider's answer (tier, rung, coordinates, kind)")

  # Why the gate refused what each provider offered for them
  audit |>
    filter(site_id %in% g_failed, !accepted, reject_reason != "no results") |>
    mutate(reason = str_extract(reject_reason,
      "administrative-area centroid|street, river or railway|returned province|unrelated|numbered name|not the office|bounding box")) |>
    count(provider, reason) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = reason, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
    kable(caption = "Why candidates for those points were rejected")
}
```

## Agreement Between Providers

For every point two providers both resolved, the straight-line distance
between their answers.

```{r}
#| label: pairwise
#| eval: true

pairs_km <- accepted |>
  select(point_set, point_id, name, provider, latitude, longitude, confidence) |>
  inner_join(accepted |> select(point_id, provider, latitude, longitude, confidence),
             by = "point_id", suffix = c("", "_2"), relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  filter(match(provider, ran) < match(provider_2, ran)) |>
  mutate(km = haversine_km(latitude, longitude, latitude_2, longitude_2),
         independent = provider_family(provider) != provider_family(provider_2))

pairs_km |>
  group_by(point_set, pair = paste(provider, "–", provider_2)) |>
  summarise(
    Points      = n(),
    `median km` = round(median(km), 1),
    `90% km`    = round(quantile(km, 0.9), 1),
    `max km`    = round(max(km), 1),
    `within agree_km` = sprintf("%d/%d", sum(km <= crosscheck$agree_km), n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  kable(caption = sprintf("Distance between providers' answers (agree_km = %s)",
                          crosscheck$agree_km))
```

```{r}
#| label: distance-to-google
#| eval: true
#| fig-cap: "Distance from Google's answer, for points both resolved (log scale). The dashed line is agree_km."

to_google <- pairs_km |> filter(provider == "google")

if (nrow(to_google) > 0) {
  ggplot(to_google, aes(pmax(km, 0.01), provider_2)) +
    geom_jitter(height = 0.15, width = 0, alpha = 0.6, aes(colour = point_set)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = crosscheck$agree_km, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1)) +
    labs(x = "km from Google", y = NULL, colour = "Point set") +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

### Calibrating `agree_km`

`agree_km` decides when two answers are the same place. It should sit above
the spread of answers that clearly are the same place, and below the distances
that mean a different place. The points both Google and an independent source
resolved at **high** confidence give that spread.

```{r}
#| label: calibration
#| eval: true

calib <- pairs_km |> filter(independent, confidence == "high", confidence_2 == "high")

if (nrow(calib) > 0) {
  calib |>
    group_by(`Point set` = point_set) |>
    summarise(
      Pairs   = n(),
      p50     = round(quantile(km, 0.50), 1),
      p75     = round(quantile(km, 0.75), 1),
      p90     = round(quantile(km, 0.90), 1),
      p95     = round(quantile(km, 0.95), 1),
      `over 5 km`  = sum(km > 5),
      `over 10 km` = sum(km > 10),
      `over 25 km` = sum(km > 25),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    kable(caption = "Distances between independent high-confidence answers (km)")
} else {
  cat("No point has high-confidence answers from two independent sources.\n")
}
```

### Disagreements

Points where two independent sources' accepted answers are more than
`agree_km` apart. At least one of them is wrong; these are the first points to
check by hand.

```{r}
#| label: disagreements
#| eval: true

disagree <- pairs_km |> filter(independent, km > crosscheck$agree_km)

if (nrow(disagree) == 0) {
  cat("No two independent sources disagree by more than", crosscheck$agree_km, "km.\n")
} else {
  disagree |>
    arrange(desc(km)) |>
    transmute(point_set, name, pair = paste(provider, "–", provider_2),
              km = round(km, 1), tiers = paste(confidence, "/", confidence_2)) |>
    kable(caption = "Independent sources more than agree_km apart")
}
```

## Chain Simulation

Every order of the providers that ran, applied to the same answers, with the
cross-check that order would produce. This costs nothing, so the orders in
`chains` (`config.R`) can be chosen from it. Success is the same for every
order, since every order holds every provider; what changes is which answer is
kept.

- **From Google**: kept coordinates that cannot be published.
- **Disagree / single-source**: kept coordinates the other sources contradict,
  or do not confirm. Both go to review.

```{r}
#| label: chain-simulation
#| eval: true

permutations <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) <= 1) return(list(x))
  unlist(map(seq_along(x), \(i) map(permutations(x[-i]), \(p) c(x[i], p))),
         recursive = FALSE)
}

sim_input <- answers |> rename(site_id = point_id)

simulate <- function(order) {
  kept <- select_chain(sim_input, order) |> crosscheck_points(sim_input)
  tibble(
    order           = paste(order, collapse = " → "),
    high            = sum(kept$confidence == "high"),
    medium          = sum(kept$confidence == "medium"),
    low             = sum(kept$confidence == "low"),
    `from Google`   = sum(kept$geocode_status == "google"),
    agree           = sum(kept$crosscheck == "agree", na.rm = TRUE),
    disagree        = sum(kept$crosscheck == "disagree", na.rm = TRUE),
    `single-source` = sum(kept$crosscheck == "single-source", na.rm = TRUE),
    review          = sum(needs_review(kept$confidence, kept$crosscheck))
  )
}

sim <- map(permutations(ran), simulate) |> list_rbind()

current <- map_chr(chains, \(ch) paste(ch[ch %in% ran], collapse = " → "))
sim <- sim |>
  mutate(set = coalesce(names(current)[match(order, current)], "")) |>
  arrange(review, `from Google`, desc(high))

sim |>
  relocate(set) |>
  kable(caption = "Every provider order, best first (fewest to review, then fewest from Google)")
```

## Gate Diagnostics

The thresholds in `gate` were calibrated on Google's responses. If they suit
the other providers too, accepted candidates should score near 1.00 and
rejected-on-name ones well below the floor.

```{r}
#| label: gate-reasons
#| eval: true

audit |>
  filter(reject_reason != "no results" | accepted) |>
  mutate(outcome = case_when(
    accepted ~ "accepted",
    TRUE ~ str_extract(reject_reason,
      "administrative-area centroid|street, river or railway|returned province|unrelated|numbered name|not the office|bounding box")
  )) |>
  count(provider, outcome) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = outcome, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  arrange(match(provider, ran)) |>
  kable(caption = "Every candidate seen, by outcome (the first reason given)")
```

```{r}
#| label: gate-similarity
#| eval: true
#| fig-cap: "Name similarity of candidates accepted and rejected on the name, by provider. Dashed lines: similarity_floor and similarity_clean."

sim_plot <- audit |>
  filter(!is.na(similarity)) |>
  mutate(outcome = case_when(
    accepted ~ "accepted",
    grepl("unrelated", reject_reason) ~ "rejected: name",
    TRUE ~ "rejected: other"
  ))

ggplot(sim_plot, aes(similarity, provider, colour = outcome)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.2, width = 0, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(gate$similarity_floor, gate$similarity_clean), linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "name similarity", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Cost

Requests are this run's; on a cached re-render they are all zero.

```{r}
#| label: cost
#| eval: true

stats |>
  group_by(provider) |>
  summarise(requests = sum(requests), cache_hits = sum(cache_hits), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(match(provider, names(providers))) |>
  left_join(tibble(provider = names(providers),
                   `rate (s/request)` = map_dbl(providers, "rate_delay"),
                   `cache days` = map_dbl(providers, "cache_days")),
            by = "provider") |>
  kable(caption = "Requests and cache hits, both workflows")
```

## Map

Each open provider's accepted answers, as a layer. Google's are left out:
its terms do not allow its coordinates on a non-Google map.

```{r}
#| label: map
#| eval: true

provider_colours <- c(grid3 = "#1b9e77", nominatim = "#d95f02",
                      photon = "#e7298a", geonames = "#66a61e")
pal <- colorFactor(unname(provider_colours), levels = names(provider_colours))

open_points <- accepted |> filter(provider != "google")

m <- leaflet(open_points) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addCircleMarkers(~longitude, ~latitude, group = ~provider,
                   color = ~pal(provider), radius = 6, fillOpacity = 0.7,
                   label = ~paste0(name, " — ", provider),
                   popup = ~paste0("<b>", name, "</b><br>", provider, ", ", confidence,
                                   " (rung ", resolved_at_rung, ")<br>", matched_address)) |>
  addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal, values = ~provider, title = "Provider") |>
  addLayersControl(overlayGroups = unique(open_points$provider),
                   options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE))
m
```
